text:
Taylor: quick roundup from the usability lab -- users keep misinterpreting the toolbar 'Preview' / 'Run' controls in the playground. they can't tell if it's for the highlighted function or the entire invocation. also many keyboard users skip tiny icon-only buttons.
Ivy: saw this in two sessions. proposal: keep the visible verb very short (Run / Preview) and add a tiny scope micro-pill that says either 'selection' or 'all'. on narrow widths that pill collapses to a chevron.
Ken: accessibility checklist: icon-only 16px is no good. we need: 1) explicit aria-labels (e.g., aria-label="Run preview for highlighted function"), 2) 24px hit target, 3) visible focus ring meeting 3:1 contrast, 4) respect prefers-reduced-motion for tooltips.
Rita: implementation constraint  toolbar is inside Monaco iframe. we'll need a small postMessage bridge for focus/shortcut forwarding. that means adding a lightweight focus relay instead of big DOM hacks.
Taylor: UX compromise: short visible button + scope pill + accessible tooltip. tooltip copy: "Runs the selected function or all functions in this invocation. Shortcut: Shift+Enter." wire tooltip to aria-describedby and ensure it appears on focus.
Ivy: microcopy tweak for run history: testers read 'Ran 3s ago' as "3s into the run". change finished state wording to 'Completed 3s ago' or 'Finished 3s ago'. for active runs use 'Running (3s)'.
Ken: status indicators also use color only. we should add an icon + short label (e.g., 'Succeeded' / 'Failed') and an aria-live region so screen readers hear state changes. include data-state attr for automation tests.
Rita: perf note: for long histories lazy-load the SVG sprite after the list renders, or replace icons with text chips until items enter viewport. we can delay sprite fetch by 100ms or on first interaction.
Taylor: function-def editor placeholder is confusing. testers think 'args: {}' is required. propose: 'Example args: {"email":"you@example.com"}' and a muted helper 'JSON or YAML examples accepted' plus a small 'Insert example' affordance.
Ivy: add inline quick-lint: green micro-check for pass, red underline + tooltip for failures. debounce lint to ~300ms to avoid flicker.
Ken: modal a11y: when tool-calling modal opens, move focus into the modal, trap focus, Escape closes and returns focus to trigger, role="dialog" and aria-modal present, announce title. I'll add automated tests.
Rita: I'll split into two PRs: PR 1 = a11y infra (aria labels, focus trap, aria-live) + postMessage bridge; PR 2 = copy updates (pill text, tooltips, placeholder), inline lint, and svg lazy-load.
Taylor: who will finalize copy? @Ivy can you author the final strings and push the small JSON diff to staging by EOD tomorrow? i'll run a 5-min follow-up with a few users.
Ivy: on it. will include aria-describedby ids and example JSON.
deploy-bot: CI: PR 6347 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke  integration tests passed.
Ken: i'll run axe on staging once Ivy's copy is up and report any violations.
Rita: tagging eng-runtime in case run-scope metadata needs a trace flag for preview scope.
Taylor: recap: short visible verbs + explicit scope pill, completed/ running tense fixes in history, status icon+label+aria-live, placeholder examples + insert, inline linting, a11y modal semantics, copy owner @Ivy, staging check by @Ken, CI green. thanks all :sparkles:
